name: @arcadeai/mcp-remote
stderr:
@arcadeai/mcp-remote - local stdio bridge for Arcade MCP gateways

Usage:
  npx @arcadeai/mcp-remote <gateway-slug-or-url>     Run the stdio bridge
  npx @arcadeai/mcp-remote login <gateway-slug-or-url>    Authorize via browser
  npx @arcadeai/mcp-remote logout [<gateway-slug-or-url>] Clear cached tokens

Arguments:
  <gateway-slug-or-url>   An Arcade gateway slug (e.g. "my-gateway") or a full
                          gateway URL (https://api.arcade.dev/mcp/my-gateway).

Options:
  --download-dir <path>   Where files returned by tools are saved
                          (default ~/Downloads/arcade).
  --no-browser            For 'login' on a headless host: print the URL instead
                          of opening a browser (forward the callback port).

Auth:
  On first run without cached tokens the bridge opens your browser to authorize,
  caches the tokens (OAuth with silent refresh), then serves silently on later
  runs. Set ARCADE_AUTO_LOGIN=0 to disable that and require 'login' to be run
  first. Alternatively, pass a token via the environment, which overrides the
  cached login (and skips OAuth entirely):
    ARCADE_API_KEY (+ ARCADE_USER_ID)   sent as Authorization: Bearer <key>
    ARCADE_TOKEN                         sent as Authorization: Bearer <token>

Environment:
  ARCADE_ENGINE_URL             Override the engine base (default https://api.arcade.dev).
  ARCADE_OAUTH_CALLBACK_PORT    Loopback port for the login redirect (default 9908).
  ARCADE_LOGIN_TIMEOUT_SECONDS  Login callback timeout (default 600).
  ARCADE_MCP_REMOTE_DIR         Credential cache dir (default ~/.arcade/mcp-remote).
  ARCADE_USE_KEYCHAIN           Set 0 to keep tokens in the file, not the OS keychain.
  ARCADE_NO_BROWSER             Set 1 for headless login (same as --no-browser).
  ARCADE_AUTO_LOGIN             Set 0 to fail instead of opening a browser when no tokens are cached.
  ARCADE_DOWNLOAD_DIR           Directory for files returned by tools.
  ARCADE_DOWNLOAD_MATERIALIZE   Set 0 to leave returned files inline (no saving).
  ARCADE_DOWNLOAD_LINKS         Set 0 to stop fetching resource_link and media URLs.
  ARCADE_DOWNLOAD_CHUNKED       Set 0 to disable chunked-download assembly.
  ARCADE_ALLOWED_DIRS           Colon-separated dirs uploads may read from (default: anywhere but credential dirs).
  ARCADE_MAX_FILE_BYTES         Max in-memory upload/download size (default 25 MB).
  ARCADE_MAX_DOWNLOAD_BYTES     Max assembled chunked-download size (default 250 MB).
  ARCADE_PUBLIC_UPLOAD_BASE     Public base URL (e.g. a tunnel to this machine) that lets tools
                                fetching a URL accept a local file path instead.
  ARCADE_UPLOAD_PORT            Local port the upload host binds (default 9909).
  MCP_REMOTE_LOG_LEVEL          debug | info | warn | error (default info).

All diagnostics are written to stderr; stdout carries only MCP protocol traffic.
